title: Thermostat deployment cadence and fallback notes (v0.9)
content:
Background:
This doc captures the 'thermostat' deployment cadence proposal (soft-throttle based on rolling latency/5xx signals), the day-of checklist, a 72-hour staggered calendar, and a draft release notes section. Intention is to run a focused mini-launch for the routing and batching changes in serving-runtime that reduce tail latency for mixed-short/long requests.

Goals:
- Roll out routing + KV cache improvements with minimal user-facing errors.
- Maintain P99 latency <= target (see SLA table below).
- Keep cost delta under 8% for the hosted tier during ramp.
- Validate auto-fallback triggers and rollback path in <15 minutes.

What 'thermostat' means here:
- We treat traffic as a thermodynamic system: when heat (latency or error rate) rises above threshold, we actively reduce load (throttle) to stable baseline lanes and route sensitive traffic to fallback models/regions. When signals calm, we allow a controlled heat-increase (ramp) back to full capacity.
- Primary levers: traffic-weight, concurrency limits, batch-size caps, routing to model-variant (quantized vs full), region steering.

Preflight checklist (must complete before gate time):
- [ ] Smoke tests pass on staging (end-to-end chat, embed, batch inference). Links: github actions run #2312.
- [ ] Canary telemetry configured (latency P50/P90/P99, 5xx count, token throughput, queue time). Metric groups named release.thermostat.* in Grafana.
- [ ] Alert runbook updated with thermostat thresholds and pager owners. Confluence page linked.
- [ ] Canary agent + sampling hooks enabled: 1% sampling of production requests for result-diffing.
- [ ] Canary dataset for quality gating uploaded (prompt set ID: PS-thermostat-v1).
- [ ] Fallback model artifacts validated (quantized-v2 checksums verified).
- [ ] Region fallbacks smoke-tested (us-west -> us-east routing validated).
- [ ] Ops slack channel #deploy-thermostat created, CI job webhooks added.
- [ ] Oncall rota set for 48 hours post-launch (primary: Daniel, secondary: Priya).

Thermostat thresholds (suggested, tune post-canary):
- Latency P99 > 1.8x baseline for 5 consecutive minutes -> throttle 20% of traffic to low-latency variant.
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3 minutes -> immediate 30% throttle and alert.
- Queue time mean > 200ms -> reduce batch size cap by 25%.

Day-of timeline (72h window, example dates are anchors for staff planning):
- T-24h (2026-09-02 09:00 UTC): Final preflight sign-off, all synthetic jobs green.
- T-3h (2026-09-03 08:00 UTC): Open rollout channel, confirm oncall presence.
- Gate T (2026-09-03 11:00 UTC): Start thermostat rollout lane 1 (1% traffic).
- T+15m: Verify canary telemetry for latency and errors. If stable -> ramp to 5% over 30m.
- T+1h: Evaluate quality diffs for sampled requests. If drift > configured threshold -> pause and investigation.
- T+3h: Ramp to 20% if signals OK, enable region steering if needed.
- T+8h: Ramp to 50% with continued monitoring.
- T+24h: If metrics stable and no customer regressions -> ramp to 100% and mark post-rollout start.
- Post T+48h: Begin rollback simulation drills (safety check).

Quick decision matrix (on-call cheatsheet):
- Spike in P99 but 5xx stable -> engage thermostat throttle (reduce concurrency and route to low-latency variant).
- Sudden 5xx spike -> immediate 30% rollback to previous model, open incident, escalate to SRE.
- Observed quality regression in sampled diffs (>3% failure in PS-thermostat-v1) -> pause ramp, run focused A/B with rollback group.

Rollback and forward-fix steps:
1) Immediate: Reduce traffic weight to previous stable variant (automated route exists: route-v1-rollback).
2) If rollback insufficient: fully exit new runtime via region drain (us-west first).
3) Post-rollback: collect core dumps, heap profiles, request traces (trace id collection prefix: thermostat-).
4) Hotfix options: kernel patch (low level), increase instance count in dedicated pool, or temporarily disable batching optimizations.

Communication plan:
- User-facing status: If more than 5% of customers affected -> publish interim status page note with ETA.
- Internal: Hourly rollup messages to #deploy-thermostat in first 6h, then cadence relaxes to every 3 hours until T+48h.

Release notes (draft):
Title: Serving Runtime: routing and KV-cache improvements (thermostat rollout)
Summary: This release introduces smarter routing heuristics and KV-cache behavior that reduce tail latency for mixed-length requests and improve throughput stability under bursty conditions. The rollout will use a staged "thermostat" cadence to limit blast radius.
What changed (user-facing):
- Lower P99 for chat-generation workloads (expected 10-25% improvement in synthetic tests).
- Reduced queue time on high-concurrency workloads due to adaptive batch caps.
- No API changes. Integrations and SDKs unaffected.
Known issues (pre-release):
- Small subset of long-context workloads may experience marginally different tokenization/response truncation in quantized variant. Workaround: pin to full-precision model via model parameter.
- Autoscaling jitter observed in a narrow CPU scheduler window (investigating).
Migration notes:
- No customer migration required. Admins can opt-out by pinning to model-variant=stable.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Can we tighten the thermostat P99 multiplier for low-risk customers? (Priya to prototype dynamic thresholds per org).
- Should we enable longer sample retention for the first week for quality diffs? Pros/cons on cost.
- Evaluate burst backlog behavior for long-tail request patterns (Omar to run 72h synthetic).

Action items (owners):
- Daniel: finalize Grafana dashboards and add release.thermostat runbook links (due 2026-09-01).
- Priya: run quality-diff sweep against PS-thermostat-v1 and prepare A/B gating script (due 2026-09-02).
- Omar: stress test region-fallback path under synthetic multi-region traffic (due 2026-09-02).
- Elena: coordinate oncall rota and final approval (due 2026-09-02).

Appendix: quick commands and links (to be pasted into #deploy-thermostat):
- Roll traffic back: ./opsctl route set weight --release thermostat --pct 0
- Throttle immediate: ./opsctl throttle apply --policy thermostat-emergency
- Fetch sampled diffs: ./tools/qdump --set PS-thermostat-v1 --since 2026-09-03T00:00Z

Notes: rough draft; expect text edits after runbook review. This doc intentionally mixes checklist bullets and operational shorthand — will be cleaned for postmortem/official runbook if rollout proceeds.
